description: Taurus decan 2 (April 30 to May 10): personality, love, work and growth, with Mercury as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Taurus.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Taurus covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly April 30 to May 10, with Mercury as its sub-ruler beside Venus. It is read as patient hands guided by a practical, curious, problem-solving mind. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 2 personality
paragraphs: From 10 to 19 degrees, Taurus picks up Mercury as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Virgo. That earthy pairing gives the Bull a sharper, more analytical edge. These natives are often pictured as makers who also want to understand: they take a clock apart to see how it ticks, then build a better one. Their thinking is concrete rather than abstract, and they tend to trust what they can test with their own hands. Speech is usually measured, with a dry wit that appears once they relax. Practical intelligence, rather than flash, is the hallmark. Ask them how something works and expect a demonstration.

Mercury introduces a restless, inquisitive thread into a sign that otherwise prefers stillness. This can make second-decan Taureans more adaptable than their first-decan neighbours, at least in method if not in values. They enjoy refining processes and spotting inefficiencies. The Virgoan undertone also brings a critical eye, which works beautifully on a draft or a budget and less well on friends who did not ask for notes. Traditional texts link this decan with commerce and skilled trade. In modern terms that often appears as a gift for turning knowledge into something useful, durable and sellable. Good tools, kept sharp, are often a quiet point of pride.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In relationships, the second-decan Bull often shows care through practical help: fixing the leaky tap, planning the logistics, remembering the exact coffee order. Conversation matters more to them than to many Taureans, and they tend to fall for someone they can talk with comfortably for hours. They may be cautious about voicing feelings, preferring actions that speak for them. Criticism, even well-meant, can creep into intimacy if left unchecked. A partner who values reliability, enjoys sensible plans and occasionally coaxes them into spontaneity tends to suit them well.

This decan is frequently drawn to work that combines skill, accuracy and tangible outcomes. Engineering, editing, accounting, carpentry, data analysis, food production and technical crafts all fit the blend of Venus taste and Mercury method. They are dependable problem-solvers who prefer clear specifications to fuzzy brainstorms. Constant interruption frustrates them; they do their best work in focused stretches. They often make excellent trainers, because they can explain a process step by step. The growth point is letting others do things differently when the result is still sound.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Taurus decan 2: what Mercury adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Taurus, which in most years means birthdays from April 30 to May 10. Its sub-ruler, Mercury, comes from Virgo, the next earth sign after Taurus, so this decan borrows a little of Virgo's character while staying Taurus at heart. The other two decans of Taurus belong to Venus (decan 1) and Saturn (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Mercury lends curiosity, quick wits and a talent for language and detail. Under its influence a sign is said to think aloud, question more, trade information freely and enjoy problems that reward cleverness more than force. Mercurial decans are often linked with writing, trade, teaching and nimble problem-solving, and their usual lesson is to finish what the quick mind starts. Set against Taurus's steadiness, sensual pleasure, patience and quiet determination, that Mercury note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Taurus decan 2
paragraphs: For second-decan Taurus, growth often lies in balancing improvement with acceptance. Before offering a correction, ask whether it is wanted and whether it matters. Practise naming feelings in words, not only in deeds, because loved ones sometimes need to hear what is already being shown. Leave a little room for experimentation that has no practical purpose, such as playing an instrument badly or drawing for fun. Learning something entirely outside a familiar field can keep Mercury curious and stop the Taurean love of routine from narrowing the world.

Within Taurus, decan 1 leans towards venusian steadiness, sensuality and loyalty at their most concentrated and decan 3 leans towards earthy patience turned into long-term ambition and lasting structures. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: How is the second decan of Taurus different from the first?
faq.answer: Mercury, the sub-ruler of the second decan, adds Virgo-style analysis and curiosity to Taurean patience. These natives are often described as craftspeople and problem-solvers, more talkative and adaptable in method than first-decan Taureans, with a sharper critical eye and a strong practical streak.

faq.question: What are the dates of Taurus decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years April 30 to May 10, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Taurus. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Taurus decan 2?
faq.answer: Mercury. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Taurus's own ruler, Venus.
